label: Holds with caveats

result.headline: NM23A is 2.19× higher in MYCN-high samples than in the rest.
lines: With your planned analysis it is called up (higher in MYCN-high).
Likely range from this data: 1.75× to 2.73× higher.
MYCN-high means top 15 % by MYCN expression.
result.verdict_sentence: Same call in 100 of 100 reasonable analyses, but removing 4 samples changes it.

lines: 144 reasonable analyses were run: every combination of choices a careful lab could defend.
The difference itself is clear (p below 0.05) in 100 of 100 of them.
Across every option tried, common shortcuts and other group cut-offs included (90,396 analyses), the same answer comes out in 72 of 100.

shortcut: Across every option tried (common shortcuts and other group cut-offs included), changing the reference genes or the group cut-off on its own also changes it.
leans: Removing 4 of the 366 samples would change the call.
The quickest way to lose the call takes at most 4 moves: normalise to 3 reference genes: ALUsq+HPRT1+SDHA; leave out sample 2530; leave out sample 1924; leave out sample 1784.
At 2.19× higher it is 9 % beyond the 2× line a call needs.
